note: Conceptual lesson on model documentation practice — no real product UI depicts this topic generically enough to screenshot honestly, so per SCREENSHOTS.md's documented exception for non-visual/conceptual lessons, no screenshot is used. The model-card concept and its standard sections (intended use, out-of-scope use, training data, evaluation, limitations) follow the widely adopted framing from Mitchell et al., 'Model Cards for Model Reporting' (2019), and match how Hugging Face's model hub structures its own model cards. The code slide is an original, LTV-authored illustrative model-card skeleton (not a claimed screenshot of any vendor tool).
